svg.title: Exits on this route
svg.desc: Exits on this route. AI-NATIVE DEVELOPMENT: Agents in every step of the lifecycle. Agent harnesses, MCP servers, skills and the governance that keeps code agents secure and confidential. Corporate AI trainings. INTEGRATION: Making systems talk. Enterprise Integration Patterns with Apache Camel on Quarkus and the Red Hat stack; payment gateways, partner and government APIs. EVENT STREAMING: Kafka at the core. Confluent, Connect, Debezium CDC and Kafka Streams; cluster tuning and disaster recovery; CQRS and GCP Pub/Sub. ARCHITECTURE: Cloud-native by design. Microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD and serverless on AWS, GCP and Azure; decisions written as ADRs. MODERNIZATION: No big-bang rewrites. Strangler Fig and CDC to move Oracle and Java legacy and old ESBs to Kubernetes and OpenShift; LDAP to Keycloak and OAuth2. PERFORMANCE: Reactive and low latency. Spring WebFlux, Vert.x and Redis; Java 21 virtual threads and Quarkus native images with GraalVM. FULL STACK: Java and Node.js end to end. Spring and NestJS services with Angular, React, Vue and Next.js frontends. PLATFORM AND QUALITY: Built to be operated. Backstage, archetypes, GitHub Actions and Terraform; OpenTelemetry and the Grafana stack; Testcontainers, k6, Gatling, chaos engineering and SonarQube. LEADERSHIP: Teams that ship. Technical leadership, code review culture, coding dojos and mentoring into senior and architect roles; presales and solution design.
